mapper.select: select dpr.id, ac.dates, ac.pkg, ac.network, ac.series, ac.ad_group, ac.material, ac.cost, ROUND(ac.cost / #{singleFee}, 8) change_cost, dpr.create_time from ods_adjust_cost ac left join dwd_promotion_record dpr on (dpr.dates = ac.dates and dpr.pkg = ac.pkg and dpr.network = ac.network and dpr.series = ac.series and dpr.ad_group = ac.ad_group and dpr.material = ac.material) where ac.dates = #{dates}
